g.title: Scheme / POO semantic contract Exact projection / allowed transforms / recipient / stream obligations
Protocol / SDK construction No upstream dial or credential
Immutable operation handoff Actor / recipient / exact payload
Ranges of admitted message Sequence / content / incarnation
Verify exact operation / Cedar checks Consume original scoped grant
Durable obligations / typed claim Bound stream start or message
Semantic / immutable-unit guard Peer / source cut / held capacity
Controlled request / message submission No retry / redirect / hedge / mirror
Admitted upstream peer One request / bounded stream
Refuse follow-up or mismatched send Claim spent / retain unknown exposure

Quint models route, retry, queue, partial-write and recovery interleavings. Lean preserves exact binding, unique start and bounded prefix authority. A route update, library retry, reconnect or cancellation never creates a new send right. Closure requires retirement of every delegated emitter.

path.aria-label: Quint models route, retry, queue, partial-write and recovery interleavings. Lean preserves exact binding, unique start and bounded prefix authority. A route update, library retry, reconnect or cancellation never creates a new send right. Closure requires retirement of every delegated emitter.
